regimeSub: Iran tit-for-tat escalation drives 10Y to 19-month high at 4.778% as Warsh hike odds solidify post-Jackson Hole.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole hike signal (Aug 28) now 'putting Fed at odds with Treasury' per CNBC (Aug 31) → 10Y hits 4.75% (19-month high per finance.biggo) as September hike pricing hardens despite 1.5% GDP
Iran tit-for-tat military exchange fuels Brent to $95.51 → Treasury selloff accelerates per Reuters (Sep 1), gold surges to $4361 as inflation/geopolitical hedges bid simultaneously
BOK Governor decoupling narrative intact: 3.00% rate with 3.3% growth forecast after back-to-back hikes (Aug 27) → KRW firms to 1369 as Shin explicitly rejects Fed followership (Aug 31 Businesskorea)

Memory sector volatility persists: Samsung/SK Hynix/Kioxia down (TradingKey Aug 28) despite Nvidia earnings beat driving AI memory rally (Mitrade Sep 1) → KOSPI at 6623 as HBM valuation reset continues
